title: Angels from the Realms of Glory
description: Angels from the Realms of Glory in Tonic Solfa to REGENT SQUARE, doh is C: the solfa with the words, staff notation, four verses and a piano.
about: James Montgomery, a newspaper editor in Sheffield, England, first printed this carol in his paper, The Iris, on Christmas Eve 1816. Henry Smart wrote the tune REGENT SQUARE, named after a London church, and first published it in 1867.
underlay: An-gels from the realms of glo-ry, Wing your flight o’er all the earth; Ye who sang cre-a-tion’s sto-ry Now pro-claim Mes_-si-ah’s birth: Come and wor-ship, come and wor-ship, Wor-ship Christ, the new-born King.

lines: Angels from the realms of glory,
Wing your flight o’er all the earth;

verses.label: Refrain
lines: Come and worship, come and worship,
Watching o’er your flocks by night,
God with man is now residing;
Seek the great Desire of nations;
Ye have seen His natal star:
Watching long in hope and fear,
